text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Wait, did we have a math pop quiz today?!

text_block_list.name: Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Yeees. The usual multiple-choice style.
Btw, it's the unit featuring Point P, which Mirako hates.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously?
N-No, if it's come to this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm betting on the pencil die!
A miracle might just happen in the clutch, after all—

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Anyone whose self-grading was below passing, make sure to thoroughly review before the next periodic exam—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle ended up getting
an utterly disastrous score on her math test...
